parts.style: calm, reverent, reading scripture aloud slowly
parts.text: Truly my soul waiteth upon God: <short pause> from him cometh my salvation. <short pause> Psalm sixty-two, verse one.

God, my soul waits quietly for You. <short pause> I am not looking anywhere else for help or hope. <short pause> You alone bring salvation. <short pause> Tonight I rest in silence before You, trusting that You will come through for me. <short pause> Amen.
